# creel

> Extract linked information from a mess or sources

- [creel.graph.canonical](_autosummary/creel.graph.canonical.html.md): Canonical JSON for creel graphs — the deterministic, versioned on-disk truth.
- [creel.graph.model](_autosummary/creel.graph.model.html.md): The in-memory Labeled Property Graph (LPG) — creel’s runtime source of truth.
- [creel.join](_autosummary/creel.join.html.md): Join the grammar and the extraction-metadata layers into a runnable plan.
- [creel.policy](_autosummary/creel.policy.html.md): ExtractionPolicy — the operational policy layer for LLM extraction (decision #13).
- [creel.render](_autosummary/creel.render.html.md): The renderer contract — the three-layer annotated-graph renderers consume (D15).
- [creel.resolve](_autosummary/creel.resolve.html.md): Entity resolution — merge nodes that name the same real entity (decision #14 / D-OP8).
- [creel.sources](_autosummary/creel.sources.html.md): Sources — the heterogeneous inputs creel reads.
- [creel.spec](_autosummary/creel.spec.html.md): creel grammar layer: declare &#42;what&#42; graph to extract, and validate instances.
- [creel.spec.linkml](_autosummary/creel.spec.linkml.html.md): LinkML bridge + schema codegen for the grammar (EPIC 2.4, decision D3).
- [creel.spec.model](_autosummary/creel.spec.model.html.md): The grammar layer: a typed description of &#42;what&#42; graph creel should extract.
- [creel.spec.validate](_autosummary/creel.spec.validate.html.md): Validate an instance &#96;Graph&#96; against a &#96;GraphSpec&#96;.
- [creel.temporal](_autosummary/creel.temporal.html.md): Reserved temporal vocabulary (decision #15 / D-OP9 — reserved, not yet enforced).
- [creel.trace](_autosummary/creel.trace.html.md): Bidirectional source↔graph traceability (ADR D-OP9 — A1, A3, A4).
- [creel.verify](_autosummary/creel.verify.html.md): creel evaluation layer: pluggable verifiers (not hardcoded equality).
- [creel.verify.graph_match](_autosummary/creel.verify.graph_match.html.md): &#96;graph_match&#96; — compare a whole extracted graph to an expected one.
- [creel.verify.kinds](_autosummary/creel.verify.kinds.html.md): The verifier-kind taxonomy — pick the comparison that matches the field’s nature.
- [creel.verify.protocol](_autosummary/creel.verify.protocol.html.md): The verifier contract — the evaluation-time dual of the extractor contract.
- [creel.verify.registry](_autosummary/creel.verify.registry.html.md): Verifier discovery: a decorator registry + entry points (group &#96;creel.verifiers&#96;).
- [creel.verify.rubric](_autosummary/creel.verify.rubric.html.md): &#96;llm_rubric&#96; — a verifier defined purely by natural-language instructions.
- [creel.view](_autosummary/creel.view.html.md): Projections of the graph into views — “one model, many views” (decision D15).
